Attribute VB_Name = "modQuote"
Option Explicit

' Quote helpers for a synthetic widget workbook.
Public Sub PriceQuote()
    Dim total As Double
    total = Range("B4").Value * 1.2
    Cells(6, 2).Value = total
    Range("D2:D3").ClearContents
End Sub

Public Function QuoteTitle(ByVal customer As String) As String
    QuoteTitle = "Quote for " & _
        customer
End Function
